eventSourceArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name of the event source

sourceAccount.description: The AWS account ID (without a hyphen) of the source owner.

sId.description: The sId (statement ID) is an identifier that you provide for each Aws Lambda Policy

principal.description:
The principal specifies who is getting this permission. For example, it can be Amazon IoT
service principal (iot.amazonaws.com) if you want Amazon IoT to invoke the function.

action.description:
The  action specifies which Amazon Lambda action is allowed in this statement, such as lambda:CreateFunction
and lambda:InvokeFunction. You can use wildcard (lambda:* ) to grant permission for all Amazon Lambda actions.

title:
Most AWS services (except for Amazon Kinesis and DynamoDB) use the push model to publish events and invoke AWS
Lambda. The AwsLambdaPolicy states the push permission for such Aws service.
name: AwsLambdaPolicy
